description: A claiming sequence: an ordered list of stages used to claim late pieces

id.description: The unique id of this claiming sequence

name.description: The name of this claiming sequence, unique per tenant (case and accent insensitive)

stages.description: Stages of this claiming sequence, ordered ascending by stage

afterLastStage.description: What happens when a piece should be claimed again after the last stage: STOP rejects the claim, REPEAT_LAST repeats the last stage

isActive.description: Inactive claiming sequences cannot be selected for new PO lines
